exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: five selected comic panels in one deterministic sequence sheet for CH05 CH05-S03
Primary request: Create a text-free 3-by-2 comic grid. The first five cells are the chronological story sequence below. The sixth cell is a quiet environment-only aftermath motif, never a duplicate character panel.
Scene/backdrop: The enclosed scale arcade, a triangular passage of suspended weigh pans and old forecast marks hidden behind market shutters. in Veyr, a gravity-rationed city built beside a continent-high vertical ocean.
Characters: Mae Nox, fictional adult woman age 41, tall and broad-shouldered, dark brown skin, one blunt black wedge braid to shoulder blades, ochre work coat, teal rope harness, heavy split-toe boots, practical mature proportions; Dax Pell, fictional adult man age 38, lean, copper-brown skin, silver-black asymmetrical curl crest leaning left, narrow moustache, coral half-cape, charcoal wrap trousers, yellow barometer gauntlet, practical mature proportions.
Non-human subjects: knot_crows.
Style/medium: pressure-print comic: bold woodcut-like dry-brush black edges, flat imperfect off-register oxidized teal, warning coral and acid-yellow risograph inks on warm fibrous paper; angular adult proportions, large readable hands, graphic negative-space force paths, simplified backgrounds except for functional machinery, one dominant value break per cell.
Color palette: coral-dominant danger, black structure, wider warm-paper silence.
Composition/framing: exact clean 3-column by 2-row grid with strong black gutters; one readable moment per cell; varied camera distance; phone-readable silhouettes; the first five cells must read left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row.
Chronological cells:
Cell 1: Establish The enclosed scale arcade, a triangular passage of suspended weigh pans and old forecast marks hidden behind market shutters.; show mae, dax, knot_crows; make geography and current load direction obvious.
Cell 2: Intent: Traverse the arcade and reach its inland loading door with the anchor-heart intact.; show the responsible adult initiating a concrete step.
Cell 3: Constraint becomes physical and visible: Counterweight pans sweep across the sloped passage, knot crows peck at charged harness cords, and Dax knows the timing too precisely to conceal prior use..
Cell 4: Causal action: Dax calls each pan before it swings; Mae pins one with her marlinspike, creating a rigid step, but knot crows sever the cradle's upper lashing and the anchor-heart strikes the pan's iron rim.; show footing, contact, rope or mechanism tension, and force direction.
Cell 5: Consequence and remaining state: Mae catches the heart before it falls, yet its casing gains a deep triangular dent; the old crew marks beside Dax's hand expose his connection to the route.; nothing resets between cells.
Irreversible state already in force: official_forecast_disproved, mae_accepts_dax_forecast, south_hook_rib_cracked, mae_right_glove_torn, mae_pull_knot_charged, mae_pull_knot_spent, dax_wanted, public_witnesses_wrong_down, tavi_joins_investigation, engine_alarm_active, weight_diversion_proven, south_hook_knows_diversion, dax_cape_hem_scorched, anchor_heart_stolen, south_hook_detachment_ordered, mae_named_compromised, anchor_heart_shared_carry_protocol, south_hook_food_stores_reduced, mae_learns_dax_withheld_route_risk, mae_right_sleeve_torn, mae_ribs_bruised, supplies_lost, inspectors_owe_mae, inspectors_share_anchor_heart_load, tagged_glass_skate_discovered, mae_compression_wrap, dax_cape_lining_cut, maintenance_gill_crossed, council_pressure_harvest_proven, glass_skate_freed, dax_breath_knot_charged, juvenile_keelback_wound_seen, dax_breath_knot_spent, engine_chain_in_keelback_confirmed, The Council's Crown coupling on the juvenile keelback has been witnessed by both Mae and Dax., The maintenance-rib shudder has begun propagating into Hook Market., Mae retains the torn right sleeve and rib compression wrap; Dax retains the scorched cape hem., Dax still has no stored breath-knot after expending it in the maintenance rib., Dax's scorched cape now has a stretched collar from braking the cart., The public stair is blocked by a loaded market cart., Mae and Dax commit to the concealed scale-arcade route..
New state that must visibly persist after this sequence: The anchor-heart casing is dented at one triangular corner., The cradle's upper lashing is severed and cannot bear full load., Mae has seen Dax's former crew mark inside the concealed arcade..
Lettering clearance: cell 1 reserve normalized rectangle [0.06, 0.06, 0.4, 0.2] as low-detail negative space; cell 2 reserve normalized rectangle [0.65, 0.09, 0.92, 0.23] as low-detail negative space; cell 3 reserve normalized rectangle [0.08, 0.69, 0.28, 0.84] as low-detail negative space; cell 4 reserve normalized rectangle [0.57, 0.68, 0.94, 0.86] as low-detail negative space; cell 5 reserve normalized rectangle [0.09, 0.07, 0.48, 0.18] as low-detail negative space.
Constraints: all humans are explicitly fictional adults with unambiguously mature proportions and practical non-sexualized clothing; exact named-character hair, silhouette, wardrobe damage, injuries and equipment persist; coherent anatomy; readable hands; visible physical cause and effect; no spontaneous healing; no extra people unless the cell explicitly calls for a fictional-adult crowd; no glamor posing.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, speech balloons, sound-effect text, logos, signatures, watermarks, floating UI, children, child-coded features, young-looking adults, sexual content, gratuitous gore, real-person likeness, third-party characters, named-artist imitation, glossy 3D, soft clear-line watercolor.
